title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Alignment Methods: Insights into Diversity, Generalisation, and Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in aggregate as part of a 'Harmlessness' and 'Safety' metric using an LLM-as-a-judge protocol. The judge assesses whether model responses discriminate, stereotype, or express hostility based on race, age, gender, religion, ethnicity, nationality, or sexual orientation using safety-focused datasets (PKU-SafeRLHF, BeaverTails, DataAdvisor).

Assessed as part of the 'Harmlessness' evaluation criteria using an LLM-as-a-judge, which penalizes responses that inappropriately handle controversial topics, sensitive issues, or political ideologies in a manner that could cause harm or conflict.
